headlines.title: 2026 BayAreaCMO ORBIE Awards Recognize Bay Area’s Top Marketing Executives
headlines.summary: Leading CMOs honored for leadership, marketing initiatives, and business impact at BayAreaCMO ORBIE Awards on October 16, 2026, at the San Jose Marriott. SAN JOSE, Calif., Oct. 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- The 2026 BayAreaCMO ORBIE Awards honored leading chief marketing officers (CMOs) from Intuit, LinkedIn, Coherent Corp, Snowflake, Chime, Cohesity, and Contentful from Salesforce for their exceptional leadership.

headlines.title: How Investors Are Reacting To Intuit (INTU) Global AI Rollout
headlines.summary: Intuit has rolled out its Intuit Intelligence platform globally across QuickBooks and Intuit Accountant Suite, bringing AI driven automation, reporting and workflow tools to millions of small businesses and accounting firms, with features now in beta for international QuickBooks Online and QuickBooks Online Advanced customers.

headlines.title: Intuit to Acquire Sequence to Boost AI-Powered Mid-Market Offerings
headlines.summary: INTU is set to acquire Sequence to enhance AI-powered revenue management, automate complex billing workflows and strengthen its mid-market ERP capabilities.

headlines.title: Intuit Bets on AI-Powered Revenue Automation with Sequence Acquisition
headlines.summary: Intuit Inc. stock is trading higher by more than 6% on Thursday after the company announced to acquire Sequence, an AI-native revenue management platform. The acquisition expands Intuit’s revenue management offerings for mid-market businesses.

headlines.title: Intuit Inc. (INTU) is Attracting Investor Attention: Here is What You Should Know
headlines.summary: Intuit (INTU) has been one of the stocks most watched by Zacks.com users lately. So, it is worth exploring what lies ahead for the stock.

description: Intuit Inc. provides financial management, payments and capital, compliance, and marketing products and services in the United States. The company operates in two segments: Global Business Solutions and Consumer. Its Global Business Solutions segment provides QuickBooks services, which include financial and business management online services, desktop software, payroll solutions, time tracking, merchant payment processing and bill pay solutions, checking accounts, and financing services for small and mid-market businesses; and Mailchimp, a marketing automation and customer relationship management. The Consumer segment provides TurboTax, a do-it-yourself and assisted income tax preparation products and services; Credit Karma, a personal finance solution that provides recommendations for credit card, home, auto, and personal loan, and insurance products; online savings and checking accounts; and access to its credit scores and reports, credit and identity monitoring, credit report dispute, credit building tools, debt pay-down assistance, credit card rewards optimization, and connected account capabilities. This segment also offers ProTax offerings which include Lacerte, ProSeries, and ProFile desktop tax-preparation software products; and ProConnect Tax Online, electronic tax filing service, and bank products and related services. It sells products and services through direct sales channels, multichannel shop-and-buy experiences, online application stores, and partner and other channels. Intuit Inc. was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in Mountain View, California.
